pc.note: Final v1 campaign ledger plus 60-second transition and 60-second pre-game memory-stop margins; shared 40 CPU-hour cap is not reset.

protocol.hypothesis: The v1 invalid-action increase is caused by simultaneous opponent movement after the policy's legal-state snapshot. A short post-override contested-target filter will preserve the loop escape while removing at least 0.20 invalid actions per game relative to v1.
protocol.changed_factor: For four decisions after a v1 loop override, redirect only a chosen directional action whose destination is occupied by or one step from an opponent; select the highest-Q remaining framework-legal action.
protocol.controls: All three arms use the identical frozen checkpoint, features, action mask, scenarios, opponents, seeds, slots, and evaluator. No training, reward, feature, architecture, or bomb-rule change.
protocol.decision: Confirm only cooldown_guard if it passes every original v1 gate and reduces pooled invalid actions by at least 0.20/game versus narrow_guard.

selection: Both fresh pilot blocks must pass. If they do, all three arms run the fixed fresh confirmation and cooldown_guard must pass again. Never promote automatically.
resource_amendment: The first v2 root stopped before any scientific game when system free memory briefly crossed the 2 GiB reserve during worker launch. The replacement root retains a 1 GiB system reserve; the 8 GiB owned-process cap, two-worker cap, scientific inputs, and gates are unchanged.
fallback_if_failed: Retain all rows and continue only with a prospectively registered anti-loop iteration inside the same budget and deadline.

authorization.record: 2026-09-20 autonomous anti-loop authorization through Monday 15:00-16:00 Berlin.
authorization.scope: Shared 40 CPU-hour cap, at most two one-thread workers; looping primary, killing only after loop success.
